about: TBC and WotLK PvP talent builds (hand-kept research, 2026-11-15) as evidence for WoW: Forever PvP builds; summary in _reference/pvp-expansion-research.md. Per class and expansion: the Classic-era guides (TBC Classic and Wrath Classic use the 2.4.3 and 3.3.5 talent trees) from Icy Veins, Wowhead (archived copies), Skill-Capped, wowtbc.gg and Warcraft Tavern, grouped by spec and use (identical builds from several sites merged; other sites' versions listed as variants in the notes with every talent difference), plus original-era ArenaJunkies forum builds (2007-2010, Wayback Machine). Talents are decoded from each source's calculator link (Wowhead-format strings on wowsims' TBC/WotLK trees, checked against Icy Veins' calculator data for order and rank caps; Icy Veins, Warcraft Tavern and old Wowhead hashes with their own encodings); each build totals 61 (TBC) or 71 (WotLK) points. 'talents': name to ranks in tree order. 'forever': for each talent of the build and of its variants, whether Forever's tree for the class has it (exact name or a rename with the same effect, named in the note), the Forever tree, and the material differences of Forever's tooltip (forever-talents/, build 1.60.1.70753; warrior and rogue 70755). Sources carry author, title, talent_link, archive and match (identical or variant) where known. Arenas and resilience shaped these builds; Forever has neither.

Nature's Grasp.note: A trainer spell in Forever, not a talent (removed from Balance); it roots the next melee attacker (1 charge, 45 s).

Improved Nature's Grasp.note: Removed in Forever; Forever's trainer Nature's Grasp roots the next melee attacker without a chance roll.

Control of Nature.note: Not in Forever; Forever's Nature's Focus gives all Nature spells, Roots included, 70% pushback protection. Forever has no Cyclone.

Brutal Impact.note: Same as WotLK (stun +1 s, Bash cooldown -30 s); TBC lacked the cooldown cut.

Thick Hide.note: Forever: base armor per level in Bear, Cat or Moonkin Form (TBC/WotLK: +10% armor from items).

Feral Charge.note: Same as WotLK: Bear charge (immobilize and interrupt 4 s) and Cat leap.

Furor.note: Moved to Feral Combat. Bear rage same; Cat Form restores the Energy you had plus 10 a second spent outside (TBC: flat 40 Energy; WotLK: keep up to 100). No Moonkin Intellect.

Natural Shapeshifter.note: Same effect (Forever row 2 of Restoration; TBC/WotLK Restoration row 2 too).

Intensity.note: As Reflection (its Classic name): 50% mana regeneration while casting (TBC 30%, WotLK 50%); no Enrage rage.

Subtlety.note: Forever: threat -30% for Nature and Arcane spells only; no dispel protection (TBC/WotLK: -30% chance to be dispelled).

Swiftmend.note: Forever heals for the full remaining periodic amount of the consumed spell (TBC/WotLK: 12 s of Rejuvenation or 18 s of Regrowth).

Empowered Rejuvenation.note: Not in Forever (Genesis, +10% periodic healing, is the nearest).

Feral Instinct.note: Same as WotLK (Swipe +30%, prowl detection); TBC's was bear threat.

Omen of Clarity.note: A trainer spell in Forever, not a talent (removed from Restoration); Moonkin Form doubles its procs.

notes: Healing-first build; Icy Veins: for teammates who need a lot of healing such as warriors; Skill-Capped: aimed at 3v3; wowtbc.gg (with Xeriyo): 3v3 or 2v2 with a warrior.
Variant, Skill-Capped (Tree Form Build) 8/11/42: Improved Regrowth 1->0; Omen of Clarity 0->1.
